_comment: Hand-maintained facts that outrank the parsed resume. master-profile.json is REGENERATED on every `npm run ingest`, so anything written directly into it is destroyed on the next run — this file is merged in by ingest.js instead and therefore survives. Edit this, never the generated profile.
_precedence: Where this file and the resume's raw_text disagree, THIS FILE WINS. The scorer and tailor both receive the whole profile object, so both see this block alongside the resume text; the note below is addressed to them.
instruction_to_model: The claims in vetted_claims are verified and may be used. Where a figure here contradicts a number in raw_text or in a section, use the figure here and ignore the resume's version. Never use anything listed under excluded_claims, in any form or paraphrase.

vetted_claims.claim: Peak personal book approximately $33M in annual sales
vetted_claims.context: Multifamily / national accounts, as Motili's first national account manager
vetted_claims.supersedes: Two figures now retired: the resume's raw_text states '~$4M in annual sales' in two places (the summary and the Multifamily role), and a prior vetted claim of '~$6M' dated 2026-08-04. Use $33M.
vetted_claims.confirmed: 2026-08-16, by Dave, in direct answer to which figure was correct

vetted_claims.claim: The multifamily segment peaked at approximately $10-12M annually
vetted_claims.context: Segment total, distinct from the personal book above — these are different numbers and can both be true

excluded_claims.reason: The GROWTH NARRATIVE is unverified — specifically the $300K starting point, from an older resume version. Still retired: never use the 'grew from X to Y' framing, in any phrasing. This is NOT the same claim as the peak figure — '$33M peak personal book' is separately vetted as of 2026-08-16 and may be used as a point-in-time number.

flagged_inconsistencies.detail: Contractor Network Manager end date reads 2015 in the current resume and 2016 in another source.
flagged_inconsistencies.resolution: UNRESOLVED. The resume's 2015 is left in place. Do not silently pick a side and do not present either date as certain.

flagged_inconsistencies.detail: A canonical timeline supplied on 2026-08-03 differs from the resume for four of six roles. The resume presents Manager of Finance and Manager of Sales Planning as ONE continuous role from Feb 2025, noting the April 2026 retitle in prose; the canonical list splits them into two roles (Manager of Finance Apr 2026-Present, Manager of Sales Planning Feb 2025-Mar 2026). The canonical list also gives Manager of National Accounts as 2021-2025 against the resume's 2022-Feb 2025, and National Account Manager - Retail & Multifamily as 2016-2021 against the resume's Sr. National Account Manager - Multifamily 2015-2022.
flagged_inconsistencies.resolution: RESOLVED 2026-08-16 by Dave: the canonical timeline supersedes the resume for role dates and titles, and is now recorded in the `employment` block below. The parsed sections and raw_text are deliberately left untouched so the resume actually sent to employers stays visible and the conflict stays auditable. Note the resume still says '~$4M' where the vetted figure is $33M — the PDF itself may need updating.

employment.note: One continuous organisation whose identity changed underneath the roles, not five separate employers. Recorded here because the resume merged roles for presentation and the parser then flattened them — which meant every fit score was computed against a wrong history.
